name: UX Layout & Control Consistency
changes: Continues the staged UX polish program with a visual-only layout, spacing and control-consistency pass across Settings, Add Media/Automation dialogs, Automation, Discover and Downloads.

Normalizes common action-button height/alignment, improves form and dialog breathing room, standardizes section/card spacing, and strengthens keyboard focus visibility without changing actions, routes or data contracts.

Preserves Newsgroup Browser geometry/performance surfaces, Automation poster/card structure, Discover media behavior, Downloads state/progress semantics, Settings persistence and all existing functional wiring.

No backend, download, Automation, Smart Import, Discover data, provider/NNTP, thumbnail scheduler, browsing concurrency, sampling, resolver timing, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, launcher/service/tray or yEnc behavior is changed.
regression_guards: v3.6.77 application logic files must normalize byte-for-byte to the exact v3.6.76 production files after replacing only the release identity string.
index.html must normalize byte-for-byte to v3.6.76 after replacing only the version/cache identity.
styles.css must equal the exact v3.6.76 production stylesheet followed only by the guarded v3.6.77 UX Polish Phase 2 override block.
The v3.6.75 Defender-compatible NewzDeckYenc.exe build profile and exact NewzDeckYenc.go source blob remain frozen.

All established schema-11 browsing, five-Image/six-Video admission, 24 MB/12-segment sampling, 800/800/1000 headers, resolver timing, Settings reliability, SABnzbd 5.1.2, terminal-history schema 3, Smart Import and Automation protections remain carried forward.
